positions.title: Technical Development Lead
positions.description: Lead architecture and technical development for key DAAS and SAAS product initiatives within the Analytics team at INRIX, leveraging AWS big data cloud infrastructure and services such as Spark on EMR, data pipelines and NoSQL storage solutions. Work includes providing thought leadership to the various technical teams at INRIX, mentoring a small team of engineers, and providing direct sales and marketing support.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Acting lead in team responsible for the authentication, account provisioning and campaign management of RESTful microservices in Java. Implemented payment and messaging interfaces to support carrier billing. Led requirements gathering, technical direction on architecture/design/story breakdown, prioritization of tasks and successfully drove projects to resolution.

positions.title: Expert Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed server-side services in JAVA for storefront catalog management, content browsing, and delivery to device handsets using Spring and Hibernate.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected a web-based management application used to monitor the health of MidStream’s family of VOD (Video-on-Demand) servers for video content streaming. Designed and implemented in Java middle tier business logic and the servlet layer used by front-end web components. Managed third-party contractors responsible for implementing the web front-end using JSP, XML and XSLT technology. Defined the MIB interface and implemented SNMP agent software in C/C++ for MidStream’s next generation V1/V2 video servers.

positions.title: Sr R&D Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed middle tier server side software in JAVA using CORBA and XML/XSLT technologies for the integration and interoperability of OSS solutions (network management systems) with accessFIBER’s network operations software. Implemented back-end stored procedures (PL/SQL) and processes (workflow) in the Oracle database to extend the physical layer management capabilities of the accessFIBER product.

positions.title: Senior R&D Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for the design and development of the next generation software solution for testing ICs with embedded mixed signal components. Platform is based on the HP93000 IC tester, targeted at the system-on-a-chip (SOC) market. Led a small team in the design and implementation of a firmware interface in C for the digital data acquisition and support of multiple clock sources used in mixed signal coherence testing techniques.
